1. endangered (adj)
/ɪnˈdeɪndʒəd/
có nguy cơ tuyệt chủng cao (cần được bảo vệ khẩn cấp)
Collocation: critically endangered species, protect endangered wildlife
"The Javan rhino is one of the most critically endangered mammals on Earth."
2. extinction (n)
/ɪkˈstɪŋkʃn/
sự tuyệt chủng hoàn toàn (adj: extinct — đã tuyệt chủng)
Collocation: on the brink of extinction, face mass extinction, save from extinction
"Unless urgent conservation measures are taken, sea turtles could face extinction within decades."
3. poach (v)
/pəʊtʃ/
săn bắn trộm, săn bắt động vật hoang dã trái phép (n: poacher / poaching)
Collocation: poach elephants for ivory, illegal poaching, anti-poaching laws
"Armed criminals continue to poach African rhinos and elephants for their horns and tusks."
4. predator (n)
/ˈpredətə(r)/
động vật săn mồi, thú ăn thịt
Collocation: apex predator, natural predators, top of the food chain
"Sharks are apex predators that play a vital role in keeping marine food chains balanced."
5. prey (n/v)
/preɪ/
con mồi (danh từ không đếm được); săn mồi (prey on)
Collocation: hunt for prey, easy prey for predators, prey on smaller fish
"When forests are cleared, wild tigers lose their natural prey and attack farm livestock."
6. marine (adj)
/məˈriːn/
thuộc về biển, đại dương
Collocation: marine ecosystems, marine mammals, marine pollution
"Dumping millions of tonnes of plastic waste into the ocean devastates fragile marine ecosystems."
7. coral (n)
/ˈkɒrəl/
san hô (rạn san hô dưới đáy biển)
Collocation: coral reefs, coral bleaching, tropical coral habitats
"Rising ocean temperatures have caused widespread coral bleaching across the Great Barrier Reef."
8. sanctuary (n)
/ˈsæŋktʃuəri/
khu bảo tồn, trung tâm cứu hộ nơi động vật hoang dã được bảo vệ an toàn
Collocation: wildlife sanctuary, marine sanctuary, nature reserve
"Injured bears rescued from illegal cages are cared for in a forested wildlife sanctuary."
9. deforestation (n)
/ˌdiːˌfɒrɪˈsteɪʃn/
nạn phá rừng trên diện rộng
Collocation: widespread deforestation, halt tropical deforestation
"Rapid deforestation for timber and palm oil has destroyed the natural habitat of orangutans."
10. captivity (n)
/kæpˈtɪvəti/
tình trạng nuôi nhốt (trong lồng hoặc bể sở thú)
Collocation: keep wild animals in captivity, born in captivity, release from captivity
"Wild predators kept in small cages in captivity often suffer from severe psychological stress."
11. breed (v/n)
/briːd/
nhân giống, sinh sản (quá khứ/분từ: bred); n: giống loài
Collocation: captive breeding programme, breed in the wild
"Conservation centres run scientific breeding programmes to increase the population of snow leopards."
12. species (n)
/ˈspiːʃiːz/
loài sinh vật (danh từ số ít và số nhiều đều viết là species)
Collocation: endangered species, native species, diverse plant and animal species
"Tropical rainforests are home to more than half of the world's terrestrial animal species."
13. ecological (adj)
/ˌiːkəˈlɒdʒɪkl/
thuộc về sinh thái học (n: ecology — sinh thái học)
Collocation: maintain ecological balance, ecological disaster
"Removing apex predators from the ocean disrupts the entire ecological balance of coral reefs."
14. threat (n)
/θret/
mối đe dọa, nguy cơ (v: threaten — đe dọa)
Collocation: pose a grave threat to, existential threat, under constant threat
"Climate change and overfishing pose a grave threat to polar bears and cold-water fish."
15. reintroduce (v)
/ˌriːɪntrəˈdjuːs/
tái thả động vật về môi trường hoang dã tự nhiên sau khi cứu hộ/nhân giống
Collocation: reintroduce wolves into the wild, successful reintroduction
"Once the young eagles learn how to hunt for prey, biologists reintroduce them into the mountains."

⚙️ 2. Bài Giảng Ngữ Pháp 2 Tầng (Grammar Masterclass)

🟢 Tầng 1: Thể Bị Động Đa Thì (Passive Voice Across Tenses) Trong Chủ Đề Bảo Tồn Sinh Thái

• Hiện tại Tiếp diễn Bị động (is / are + being + V3/ed): Nhấn mạnh hành động tàn phá đang diễn ra ngay lúc này.
  Ví dụ: Vast areas of rainforest are being cleared, and elephants are being poached for ivory.

• Hiện tại Hoàn thành Bị động (have / has + been + V3/ed): Nhấn mạnh hậu quả kéo dài từ quá khứ đến hiện tại.
  Ví dụ: Over the past century, hundreds of endangered species have been pushed to the brink of extinction.

• Bị động với Động từ Khuyết thiếu (must / should + be + V3/ed): Đưa ra giải pháp chính sách trong Task 2.
  Ví dụ: Protected marine sanctuaries must be established, and rescued animals should be reintroduced into the wild.

🔵 Tầng 2: Câu Điều Kiện Cảnh Báo Với 'Unless' & 'Provided That' (C1 GRA Boosters)

• Cấu trúc cảnh báo sinh thái với Unless + S + V (Hiện tại đơn khẳng định), S + will + V (= If ... not ...):
  Ví dụ: Unless strict anti-poaching laws are enforced immediately, many apex predators will face extinction within decades. (Lưu ý: Tuyệt đối không dùng 'don't/aren't' ngay sau Unless).

• Cấu trúc đặt điều kiện chặt chẽ với Provided that / As long as + S + V (Miễn là / Với điều kiện là):
  Ví dụ: Captive breeding programmes are justifiable, provided that the animals are raised in spacious sanctuaries and eventually reintroduced into the wild.

🎯 20 Câu Test Từ Vựng (Vocabulary Mastery Test)

1. The Amur leopard is listed as critically ________ because fewer than 100 individuals survive in the wild.
2. Conservationists warn that many sea turtle populations are on the brink of ________ due to plastic pollution.
3. Despite international bans on the ivory trade, armed gangs still ________ elephants in national parks.
4. As an apex ________ at the top of the food chain, the grey wolf regulates deer populations in the forest.
5. Owls have exceptional night vision and silent wings, allowing them to swoop down on unsuspecting ________.
6. Oil spills and discarded fishing nets pose a severe danger to whales, dolphins, and other ________ mammals.
7. Tropical ________ reefs shelter a quarter of all ocean fish, yet they are dying due to warming seas.
8. Orphaned orangutans rescued from illegal logging sites are cared for at a forest ________ in Borneo.
9. Widespread ________ in the Amazon basin destroys wildlife habitats and accelerates global warming.
10. Marine biologists argue that intelligent killer whales should not be kept in ________ for circus shows.
11. Giant pandas are notoriously difficult to ________ in zoos, making every newborn cub a major success.
12. Biologists discovered three previously unknown ________ of frogs during their expedition in the rainforest.
13. Removing sharks from the ocean causes a domino effect that disrupts the fragile ________ balance.
14. Rising sea temperatures and overfishing pose an existential ________ to cold-water marine life.
15. After decades of absence, conservationists successfully ________ grey wolves into Yellowstone National Park.
16. [Ôn tập Unit 18] Prolonged ________ and water shortages have devastated agricultural harvests in East Africa.
17. [Ôn tập Unit 18] Spraying chemical ________ on fields kills pests but also harms wild honeybees.
18. [Ôn tập Unit 17] At the final stage, electricity is stepped up and ________ to the national power grid.
19. [Ôn tập Unit 16] Childhood ________ programs have successfully eradicated polio in most countries.
20. [Ôn tập Unit 15] Strict anti-poaching ________ must be enforced to punish wildlife traffickers.
Điểm: 0/20

⚙️ 10 Câu Test Ngữ Pháp Ứng Dụng (Grammar Mastery Test)

1. Every year, thousands of endangered sea turtles ________ accidentally in commercial fishing nets.
2. Right now, vast areas of tropical rainforest ________ down to create grazing land for cattle.
3. Over the past fifty years, nearly 60% of global coral reefs ________ by ocean warming and pollution.
4. Unless strict anti-poaching laws ________ immediately, the Javan rhino will become extinct within a decade.
5. Note that 'species' can be singular or plural: This rare snow leopard species ________ only in the Himalayas.
6. Rescued wildlife should only be kept in captivity ________ they are eventually reintroduced into the wild.
7. Heavier prison penalties must ________ on illegal poachers and wildlife traffickers to deter crime.
8. Having ________ in a marine sanctuary for two years, the injured dolphin was finally released into the ocean.
9. Rapid deforestation strips tigers of their natural prey, ________ them to attack farm livestock.
10. Neither commercial logging nor illegal poaching ________ permitted inside the national wildlife sanctuary.
Điểm: 0/10

Sanctuary Coordinator: Good morning, BlueHorizon Marine and Wildlife Sanctuary, Dr. Maya Lin speaking. How may I help you?
Biology Student: Hello Dr. Lin! My name is Liam O'Connor. I am a marine biology student, and I am calling to apply for your Summer Conservation Volunteer Programme.
Sanctuary Coordinator: Delighted to hear from you, Liam! Could you confirm the spelling of your surname without the apostrophe for our database?
Biology Student: Yes, it is O - C - O - N - N - O - R. 💡 Đáp án câu 1 (Họ tình nguyện viên): OCONNOR / O'CONNOR
Sanctuary Coordinator: Thank you! Which conservation project are you most eager to join this summer?
Biology Student: I want to help protect endangered sea turtles and ocean habitats.
Sanctuary Coordinator: Wonderful! At night, volunteers patrol the nesting beach to protect female turtles from illegal poachers. 💡 Đáp án câu 2 (Tuần tra đêm bảo vệ rùa khỏi): poachers
Biology Student: Do volunteers also work underwater to restore marine ecosystems during the day?
Sanctuary Coordinator: Yes! Every morning, our diving team plants healthy coral fragments on damaged reefs to restore the ecological balance. 💡 Đáp án câu 3 (Trồng các nhánh san hô khỏe mạnh): coral
Biology Student: How long is the volunteer placement, and what is the weekly accommodation contribution?
Sanctuary Coordinator: The minimum commitment is 3 weeks. Volunteers contribute 240 pounds per week to cover eco-cabin lodging, meals, and diving gear. 💡 Đáp án câu 4 (Chi phí mỗi tuần): 240
Biology Student: Two hundred and forty pounds a week with food and diving gear included is very fair. Are there any skill requirements?
Sanctuary Coordinator: Yes, all marine volunteers must hold a basic Scuba Diving certificate and swim 400 metres. 💡 Đáp án câu 5 (Chứng chỉ bắt buộc): Scuba / Scuba Diving
Biology Student: I already have my Open Water scuba licence! Where does the sanctuary boat pick us up on the first day?
Sanctuary Coordinator: Our ferry departs from Dolphin Pier at 10:00 AM sharp every Monday. Welcome aboard, Liam! 💡 Đáp án câu 6 (Bến tàu khởi hành): Dolphin

📰 IELTS Academic Reading: Passage & Questions

[Paragraph A - Human Activity Driving Mass Extinction on Land]
Biologists warn that the Earth is currently experiencing its sixth mass extinction, driven entirely by human activity. Over the past century, the disappearance of plant and animal species has accelerated dramatically. On land, relentless deforestation for timber and agriculture has destroyed natural habitats, while organized criminal networks continue to poach critically endangered mammals such as elephants, rhinos, and tigers for illegal markets.

[Paragraph B - Threats to Marine Ecosystems and Food Chains]
Beneath the waves, marine ecosystems face an equally grave threat. Rising ocean temperatures and acidification have triggered widespread coral bleaching, destroying the tropical coral reefs that shelter a quarter of all ocean life. Simultaneously, industrial overfishing has decimated populations of apex predators like sharks. When these top predators are removed from the food chain, populations of smaller prey explode uncontrollably, disrupting the entire ecological balance of the seas.

[Paragraph C - Commercial Captivity versus Ethical Wildlife Sanctuaries]
For decades, traditional city zoos claimed to protect wildlife by keeping rare animals in captivity. However, confining large predators or intelligent marine mammals in small concrete cages causes severe psychological stress and fails to teach them how to hunt for prey. By contrast, modern wildlife sanctuaries focus on habitat preservation and ethical captive breeding. In these spacious reserves, endangered animals are bred with minimal human contact and are gradually reintroduced into the wild once anti-poaching laws are enforced.
Điểm: 0/6

✍️ Academic Writing Lab (Task 2 Discussion): Nuôi Nhốt Động Vật Trong Sở Thú (Captivity) vs. Khu Bảo Tồn Tự Nhiên (Wildlife Sanctuaries)

Đề bài: Some people believe that keeping wild animals in captivity in zoos is cruel and that all zoos should be closed. Others argue that zoos play an essential role in protecting endangered species from extinction through breeding programmes. Discuss both views and give your opinion (90 - 120 words).

Tiêu chuẩn: Sử dụng Thể Bị Động đa thì (are kept / are bred / are reintroduced), câu điều kiện cảnh báo/điều kiện (Unless... will... / Provided that...) và ít nhất 6 từ vựng Unit 19.
